title: Renfe official train discount for Valencia Marathon runners and companions
claims: Runners and companions receive a minimum 15% Renfe discount on AVE and long-distance services (AVE, Alvia, Euromed, Intercity) to Valencia between 1 and 13 December 2026.

The discount authorisation is issued through the organiser's Self-Management Area after registration verification and must be shown with the ticket; tickets are bought on renfe.com using the NEC Congress/Fairs tariff and the authorisation number.
